gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-old-turkic: Flavors is whimsical, with no calligraphic swelling anywhere along its outlines. Noto Sans Old Turkic brings open-mouthed curves and chunky, tall lowercase, and that shared sturdiness is what makes the pair work.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Flavors holds its thickness constant in every direction, whimsical and commanding, with a towering x-height. And Noto Sans Oriya, with generous curve gaps and small letters nearly capital-high, rises to meet it on the page.
